wins: Successfully completed initial reconnaissance and collected service banners on first-touch systems with mentor guidance.
Maintained consistent interaction with mentors (10 calls) to rapidly iterate on tactics despite lack of success.
fails: Failed to translate reconnaissance data into a foothold, resulting in zero successful episodes.
No lateral movement or privilege escalation attempts completed; exploit paths were never finalized before episode termination.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough but follow-up exploitation and escalation planning stalled, leaving the overall run unsuccessful despite disciplined mentor collaboration.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to complete an exploit chain after identifying SSH service because no follow-up action triggered before episode end.
Stayed in reconnaissance phase without progressing to post-exploitation, even when critical ports were enumerated.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is captured
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH-specific nmap scripts plus default credential checks

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 on port 80/443 reveals identifiable apps
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted vulnerability scans (Nikto/httprint) and catalog results in action log

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields subdomains or IP ranges with no immediate exploit path
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger OSINT scripts to map dependencies and outline potential attack surfaces for next iteration

memory_ops.reason: High confidence in SSH enumeration as a repeatable reconnaissance success.
